description: Java entity class representing a Payment in the insurance management backend, including fields for references, associations with policies, users, and claims, and payment details.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Entity class for recording payment transactions such as premiums or payouts related to insurance policies and claims.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the user who made the payment.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the user who made the payment.

methods.name: getClaim
methods.description: Returns the associated claim, if any.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of the payment.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the payment.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the payment direction ('IN' for premium, 'OUT' for payout).

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the payment.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the payment.
